title: Female Representation in Statutory Boards and Listed Companies
what_it_is: Female Representation in Statutory Boards and Listed Companies

sections.label: Women's representation and gender salary gap
sections.summary: Ms Anthea Ong asked the Minister for Social and Family Development about female representation targets, closing the gender salary gap, and gender equality imbalances.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of Ms Anthea Ong 	– 1 To ask the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) how we are doing with our target for 20% female representation in Statutory Boards and listed companies by 2020; (b) what steps are being taken to close the gender salary gap of about 20%; and (c) in view of the upcoming International Women's Day theme of #BalanceforBetter, what are existing imbalances in our gender equality pursuit that we must balance for a better Singapore.
